sources.summary: Located in Pouca Farinha, Porto Covo , on a 4,750 m² site, the house is developed largely over the footprint of pre-existing ruins, responding to the environmental and territorial conditions of the site. With 189 m², the project adopts a restrained approach, concentrating the construction within an area that had already been transformed while seeking to preserve its relationship with the surrounding landscape.
